title: Smash a man to atoms
html_source: A repeat of Bloom’s utilitarian mind set which we read at Paddy Dignam’s funeral. His internal narrative leaves us in no doubt that his cognitive leanings are far removed from those of Stephen.

anchor.prefix:
bly. Thumping. Thump.
WITH UNFEIGNED REGRET IT IS WE ANNOUNCE THE DISSOLUTION OF A MOST RESPECTED DUBLIN BURGESS

This morning the remains of the late Mr Patrick Dignam. Machines.
anchor.suffix: if they got him caught. Rule the world today. His machineries are pegging away too. Like these, got out of hand: fermenting. Working away, tearing away. And that old grey rat tear
